title: Comfort Club Member Relief on Home Comfort Financing Fixed-Rate Interest
content:
Comfort Club members who finance an installation on a Home Comfort Financing fixed-rate plan receive a relief on the rate at which statement interest is charged.

**Terms.** The fixed-rate member relief is 15 percent when the borrower's Comfort Club agreement is active and has run at least 5 consecutive terms, 8 percent when that agreement is active and has run fewer than 5 consecutive terms, and zero when the borrower holds no active Comfort Club agreement. Status and consecutive terms come from the borrower's agreement on the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements side.

**How it applies.** The fixed-rate charging rate is the starting rate reduced once by the fixed-rate reliefs added together; the reliefs never act one after another. The member relief is one of them.

| Borrower's Comfort Club position | Fixed-rate member relief |
|---|---|
| active agreement, 5 or more consecutive terms | 15 percent |
| active agreement, fewer than 5 consecutive terms | 8 percent |
| no active agreement | zero |

## Illustrations (hypothetical members)

- *In the 7th consecutive term, active:* 15 percent.
- *Exactly 5 consecutive terms, active:* 15 percent — the threshold is "at least 5".
- *4 consecutive terms, active:* 8 percent.
- *Agreement cancelled last spring:* zero.

*Effect on a rate (hypothetical).* A starting rate of 9.74 percent with a fixed-rate relief total of 15 percent: 9.74 multiplied by 85 and divided by 100, 8.279 percent.
